qt: to the Commission Özlem Demirel (The Left) Subject:

Frontex is developing digital information tools to implement the reform of the Common European Asylum System (CEAS), particularly with regard to forced or voluntary ‘returns’ connected with the reform. One such tool is RECAPP, which is already in use in Italy. 1.
What digital apps is Frontex developing or providing in order to implement the CEAS reform, and which apps explicitly deal with forced or voluntary ‘returns’?
What details can Frontex provide on the costs, developers, capabilities, target groups and purposes of the RECAPP app and on where the app is already in use?

What studies has Frontex carried out itself on the relevant legal, technical and operational aspects of implementing the Migration Pact using such as RECAPP, and what other studies is Frontex aware of?

(26 March 2026) As the question falls under the responsibility of the European Border and Coast Guard Agency (Frontex), the Commission has asked the Agency to provide a response to the question raised by the Honourable Member. The Commission will send the Agency’s reply to the Honourable Member as soon as possible. See annexes: Annex 1, Annex 2.
